messages:
sam_cs: Quick heads-up: we have a pre-QBR dry-run for NovaHealth on Friday. Objective: land a single cost slide + top-5 prompt heatmap + a 1-paragraph renewal ask. Who can pull prompt-level token usage and surface any obvious inefficiencies? Need something I can paste into the deck by Thu afternoon.

julie_fin: I can run cost scenarios. Will prepare three bullets: (1) baseline 90d projection, (2) conservative with 15% optimization, (3) reserved-commit ask impact. Will also include estimated $ delta.

leo_prod: I'll extract prompt samples and token counts. Plan: query the prod analytics table for last 45d, group by prompt hash, return top 50. Sample SQL below, will paste CSV link when ready.

leo_prod: ```sql
SELECT prompt_hash, prompt_name, SUM(tokens) as total_tokens, COUNT(*) as calls
FROM prod_events
WHERE customer_id = 'novahealth' AND ts >= now() - interval '45 days'
GROUP BY prompt_hash, prompt_name
ORDER BY total_tokens DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

ops-bot: NOTE: NovaHealth usage alert: currently at 68% of monthly threshold (threshold=750,000,000 tokens).

sam_cs: Thanks. Leo, can you flag prompts that are >1% of total tokens and mark which are embeddings vs gen? Julie, please assume public pricing for initial ask and include a reserve cushion suggestion (15% recommended).

leo_prod: Uploaded CSV to https://internal.redwood/data/nova-prompt-45d-2999990001.csv. Top 5 prompts attached in the CSV. Quick preview: "daily_digest_generation" = 2.8M tokens total (gen), "semantic_search_index" = 1.1M tokens (embeds), "chat_assist_longform" = 1.5M tokens (gen).

julie_fin: Initial numbers: 90d baseline = $9.4k. If we apply a 15% batching/cache strategy on the top-3 gen prompts, estimated 90d = $7.6k. Reserved-commit ask (3mo, 20% discount) reduces net spend to ~$6.1k and gives Sales talking points for renewal. I'll put math in the slide notes.

nina_sales: For renewal framing, recommend offering a limited-time pilot: 8-week batching pilot + 10% credit on first invoice if they commit to 3mo reserve. Keeps them engaged and reduces churn risk. I'll draft the sentence for the ask slide.

sam_cs: Great. Two operational asks: 1) Leo — provide a tiny anonymized sample of 5 prompt texts for PR review (avoid PHI), 2) Ops — prepare fallback play if daily burn spikes >25% day-over-day during the quarter.

ops-bot: ACTION: set alert rule suggestion -> trigger when customer_daily_total > baseline_daily_avg * 1.25 for 2 consecutive days. Example command for infra team: 
```bash
redwood alerts create --customer novahealth --metric daily_tokens --threshold 1.25 --window 2d --notify ops@redwood
```

leo_prod: Sample prompts sanitized and uploaded to https://internal.redwood/snippets/nova-samples-2999990001.txt. Also added a small column tagging likely optimization (cacheable / compressible / unchanged).

julie_fin: Finished cost slide draft. Link: https://internal.redwood/decks/nova-qbr-prep-2999990001 (will be the version I drop numbers into). I'll include a tiny table with baseline, optimized, reserved numbers and a recommended ask phrasing for Sales.

sam_cs: Perfect. I'll run the dry-run Thu 5pm PT with Sales and Product. Please have final CSV + slide link by Thu 3pm PT. Thanks everyone :pray:

leo_prod: On track, delivering CSV and top-5 heatmap by 2pm Thu.

julie_fin: Cost tables done by 3pm Thu.

nina_sales: I'll bring the renewal script and the pilot wording to the dry-run.

sam_cs: No other blockers. Closing thread and assembling deck later today.
